dct_title_s: Lar circofereza di tutto il Veronese
dct_description_sm: Bar scale on map given in “Scala de miglia.”
Decorative cartouches, compass roses, descriptive text.
"Al molto mag.co S. Nicola Rambaldo..." in cartouche to far left.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 475.
